title: Syutsai: your map and weekly energy
intro: Enter your birth date once. The app builds a personal map and refreshes practical guidance every week, locally and without an account.
privacy: Your birth date and test results stay on this device.
improve: Take more tests so the forecast can reflect how you actually decide and work.
howText: Scores describe compatibility between the weekly theme and your usual style—not luck or predicted events.
disclaimer: Syutsai and number cycles are entertainment and esoteric interpretation, not scientific assessment or prediction.

texts.theme: This week emphasizes {theme}. Your strongest mode is {top}. Use the weekly theme as an extra tool instead of changing who you are.
texts.boost: This week plays on your field. Pick one meaningful launch instead of five starts.
texts.compensation: The week asks for a slightly different pace. Give that mode one controlled block instead of forcing a new personality.
texts.neutral: There is no strong conflict. A clear priority matters more than trying to do everything.
texts.work: Compatibility {score}/10. Define one visible outcome, then time-box preparation.
texts.money: Not an income prediction: calculate consequences and sleep on large impulsive choices.
texts.relations: Speak directly and leave room for an answer. One honest conversation beats five guesses.
texts.decisions: Move quickly on reversible steps; recheck expensive and long-term choices.
texts.energy: Plan load in waves: important block, short pause, then routine work.
texts.risk: Your strength in {top} may become overuse: preparing too long or carrying everything alone.
texts.window: Best window: an action where {top} meets “{theme}”. Make it visible and measurable.
texts.avoid: Do not start five things; promise under pressure; or confuse fatigue with lack of ability.
texts.mode: One priority, one conversation, one obligation-free evening.
texts.joke: Weekly kryptonite: “one more tab and I will definitely decide.”

core: Your core is {top}; your second anchor is {second}. Together they describe your usual way of acting, while the number cycle only shifts the weekly focus.
shadowText: Under pressure, your strength in {top} can become overuse. Check whether preparation is taking longer than the task itself.
resourceText: You work best with a clear priority, room for your strongest trait, and a pause that is planned rather than earned.
